panel: original 36 shape-donor images and six fixed teachers only
split: rank size and angle from zero. Even rank sum is development. Odd is held out. Use only cyclic 0->1,1->2,2->0 in each cell, no reverse counterpart. All masks, strengths and teachers keep a cell on the same side.
proper_inputs: Each prediction uses only the 7 proper subsets of its triple, in the same directed pair. No other pair's states. Per pair the union costs 11 low-order states and one empty-state three-logit Jacobian. No scored triple queries in prediction.
training: full strength only, on 6 development cells. Freeze all six fitted channel lists and regressions, then all held-out predictions, before running the evaluator.
rule: QX = Xab+Xac+Xbc-Xa-Xb-Xc+X0. Predict block2 first ReLU third residual ru = relu(za+zb+zc-2z0)-Qu. Keep K=4 first channels by development ru energy. For outgoing channel c, estimate missing final preactivation by bn-scaled conv2 weight from K times ru. Predict rc=relu(Qv+conv(ru))-Qh. Choose C=4 middle channels by development reduction in whole-field squared third-residual error, all other corrections zero. Whole middle prediction is Qh+rc. Three predicted output logits are Qlogits + empty-state Jacobian times rc. Offsets of the shortcut and BN cancel in the order-three correction. SAME lists for every test case and both strengths.
baselines: quadratic analytic Q, linear ridge on the same low observations per selected channel, development mean per shape transition and triple for logits, upstream correction omitted, second ReLU fixed to its empty gate. Ridge uses five site features (v0,h0,Qv-v0,Qh-h0,propagated ru), with centered and standardized features, development-only means and scales, lambda=0.01 times number of sites after standardization. Ridge, ablations and main rule share the same four channels, empty Jacobian and logit baseline.
patch: Across all eight subset states freeze the specified block2 channels to their real empty-state activations, recompute original tail, then form the signed third difference. Removed = natural third difference minus blocked third difference. Keep = third difference with only the chosen channels changing. Predicted removed and keep equal sum of predicted selected-channel contributions in the frozen linear readout correction. Primary is all four C. Controls are two fixed uniform disjoint-from-C draws of four channels, and per held-out case strongest and weakest of C by absolute predicted signed channel contribution, tie by physical channel ID. Rank using predictions only. For outside-C controls the sparse rule predicts zero. No channel search during scoring.
stratification: Above versus at/below each teacher's development median absolute predicted task correction. Use same threshold at both strengths. Report actual blocking impact in both strata including null and failed cases.
metrics: For each teacher separately, root(sum squared prediction error / sum squared truth) of third residual across held-out cases. Whole middle field including all channels. Also selected middle field, total change relative to empty, sign accuracy for measurable scalar targets, per-case signed raw predictions, interventions and class logits. Equal teacher averages and counts; no independent-case p-values. A zero denominator is missing.
decision: Primary strength 1.0. Each of four links (whole-middle third residual, output contrast third residual, selected-channel removed, selected-channel keep) must achieve a mean normalized error <=0.95 and a ratio <1 in at least four of six teachers. All four links must pass for support of the tested complete mechanism. Report same-input ridge and class-mean separately; no superiority claim over a stronger control unless observed. Secondary half strength and subgroups may not rescue a failed primary criterion.
interpretation: Retrospective grouped holdout on an already explored panel. Directions and savings under this specific matched intervention. Complete enumeration or passing a score alone gives no evidence for exclusive wiring.
